provenance.author: AUD-07 C12 (Claude)
provenance.notes: AUD-07 C12 corrected rule: a fill inside a candle sees only the declared path (zb-path/1) after the first touch of the fill price. Limit = signal close 100. Candle 280 is red (101, 106, 99.5, 99.8): path open -> high -> low -> close, so 100 is first touched on the high -> low leg AFTER the high. Fill 100 (maker fee 0.0002), ATR 1, R 2: stop 98, target 102. Remainder of 280 after the fill: 100 -> 99.5 -> 99.8 (no stop, no target). Candle 281 flat at 99.8 (wick 0.5: 99.3..100.3). Time exit (N = 2) at the close of 281: 99.8 x 0.9998 = 99.78004. qty 10 / 2 = 5; pnl = 5 x (99.78004 - 100) - 5 x 100 x 0.0002 - 5 x 99.78004 x 0.0005 = -1.0998 - 0.1 - 0.2494501 = -1.4492501; R = -1.4492501 / 10. Before C12 the backtest walked 280 from its open and booked the target 102 on the up-leg BEFORE the limit could fill (TP_FULL at 280). Maker fill rate / price are uncalibrated against live fills (BT-08).
